title: Polynomial time for countdown initialization
statement: Let $h_0$ be a bit string, let $x,r$ be polynomial-time computable functions on bit strings, and let $a',k'\in\mathbb{N}$. Then the function sending $z$ to $\langle h_0,\langle 1^{a'(|x(z)|+1)^{k'}},r(z)\rangle\rangle$ is polynomial-time computable.
